David Pyle, Council Intern, said both Parks and Recreation and the Sustainability Committee had indicated support for the proposed agreement with Xerces Society for Invertebrate Conservation for Provo to become a member of Bee City USA.

An implied motion to approve Ordinance 2025-22, as currently constituted, has been                     made by Council rule. City Planner Hannah Salzl presented proposed Ordinance 2025-22 to amend the Conservation and Resiliency Plan to include a new appendix committing Provo to be a Bee City USA affiliate.
